subject: Contoso co-sell: account pairing & field matchmaking
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@contoso.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + high level ask: Contoso co-sell coverage

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the intro to the team. Quick context: Contoso is prioritizing a pilot to resell our inference offering across their Azure accounts focused on retail and telco lines of business. They asked for a simple seller map and an agreed next-step list to get a Partner Center referral created and routed to an assigned field seller. Can your team share a proposed pairing and the minimum info the field needs to accept referrals?

Appreciate it,
Alex

-- 
Alex Johnson
Sr. Program Manager, Cloud Partnerships
Contoso
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@contoso.com>, Azure Marketplace Ops <marketplace@azure.com>
Date: 2027-06-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + high level ask: Contoso co-sell coverage

Thanks Alex — looping in Vanessa and Ben to propose the seller pairing and the minimal referral payload.

High-level plan I propose:
- Vanessa to confirm partnercenter seller target per Contoso account tiles (will attach mapping)
- Ben to own the seller outreach and onboarding for initial demo
- Laura to coordinate the referral creation and validate regional eligibility with Partner Center

Questions for you, Alex:
1) Which Contoso business units first (retail/telco)?
2) Any compliance constraints we should know per account (data residency, SOC reports)?

Attaching a first-draft account mapping (xlsx) and a short mutual-action-plan PDF.

Next steps: 30m sync Wed the 23rd? Suggested agenda: account-to-seller mapping, referral payload, timeline to create Partner Center referral.

Thanks,
Karthik

Attachments: Contoso_Account_Mapping.xlsx (spreadsheet), Draft_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.pdf (PDF)

-- 
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships, Americas
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@contoso.com>
Date: 2027-06-23T09:16:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + high level ask: Contoso co-sell coverage

All — quick sync notes from the Wed 23rd call (see attached mapping v1):

- Primary BU: Retail (accounts A, B, C). Secondary: Telco (account D).
- Recommended seller matches:
  - Account A -> Ben Carter (west region seller)
  - Account B -> Laura Bennett (central enterprise seller)
  - Account C -> Ben Carter (handles retail higher-touch)
  - Account D -> Triage (need to confirm telco specialization; recommended field rep: Marcus Lin — will confirm availability)
- Minimal referral payload (for Partner Center): account tenant ID, estimated ARR band, primary contact, technical contact, preferred region, product SKU (redwood-inference-hosted), reason for referral (proof-of-concept pilot), expected go-live window.
- Compliance flags: Account B requires EU data residency for some workloads; will require Private deployment option and KMS.

Action items:
- Vanessa to submit owner roster to Partner Center drafting tool and tag Ben/Laura.
- Ben to schedule seller intro to Contoso lead and prep demo brief.
- Karthik to update mutual action plan with timeline (week-by-week).
- Alex to confirm Marcus's telco contact and share tenant IDs for accounts D.

Thanks,
Vanessa

Attachments: Contoso_Account_Mapping_v1.xlsx

-- 
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Partner Manager, EMEA & Americas
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@contoso.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-25T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + high level ask: Contoso co-sell coverage

Alex — great to meet you virtually. Quick note: I can take primary ownership of Account A and C for the pilot. Proposed next steps from seller side:

1) 45m demo + technical Q&A next Tue (July 1) — I'll bring SE and product PM
2) Share a 1-pager on integration points (will attach)
3) Confirm referral accept criteria once Vanessa submits the Partner Center intake

One question: for Account A, who is the technical contact and do they have an existing Azure subscription tied to our expected SKU? That will speed the referral.

Ben

-- 
Ben Carter
Field Seller, West
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Seller_Demo_Brief.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@contoso.com>, Azure Marketplace Ops <marketplace@azure.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + high level ask: Contoso co-sell coverage

Following up on status — Partner Center entry created (referral id abc-123) and routed to Ben as the assigned seller for Accounts A/C. Azure Marketplace Ops copied for visibility.

Notes:
- Referral payload included tenant IDs for A/C; still need tenant ID for B and D before we can route those.
- Account B flagged for EU data residency; Partner Center will hold pending KMS details.
- Marcus Lin confirmed he can triage Account D but is out Aug 2–12; contingency plan is to assign to Rishi Malhotra if immediate outreach required.

Next steps:
- Karthik to finalize week-by-week MAP and confirm dates for POC start.
- Alex to provide tenant IDs for B/D and confirm Telco contact for D.
- Vanessa to close the seller onboarding checklist for Ben.

Great progress — setting an internal brief for Friday to align go/no-go for POC kickoff.

Laura

-- 
Laura Bennett
Partner Programs Ops
Redwood Inference
